## The honest summary of this section

Six claims. Of the six, exactly one (F-03) has an observable that exists today. Two (F-01, F-04) depend on interviews that have not happened. Two (F-02, F-06) depend on interviews and public data that also do not exist yet. One (F-05) depends on a signed contract.

In other words: **every load-bearing claim in this market sizing is currently untestable**, because the programme has conducted zero primary interviews. That is not a flaw in the method - the method is doing exactly what it should by saying so - but it does mean the sizing should be presented as a structured hypothesis with a known verification path, not as an established market fact.
